programme.desc: Detective Lin sets up a special unit to investigate the crime syndicate behind a series of thefts. In the process, his pregnant wife is attacked, leading him to uncover their revenge plan.

programme.title: From Vegas To Macau
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat stars as a retired gambling genius who is challenged to a high stakes game to elicit his kidnapped daughter's freedom.

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A computer geek who has only been in love once suddenly & surprisingly finds himself getting romantically involved with five different women. Will he find "the-one"?

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who can enter a person's subconscious. As she investigates a murder-cum-suicide case, she finds herself under suspicion and comes face-to-face with a past trauma...

programme.title: Enter the Fat Dragon
programme.desc: A demoted super cop who has become overweight receives a lifeline to save his career and win back his ex-fiancee when he is tasked to repatriate a Japanese fugitive.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: A Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: In this Golden Horse winner starring Gordon Lam, a retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian drug mule.

programme.title: Sifu VS Vampire
programme.desc: In a selfish grasp at financial gain, a TV station tycoon intimidates a feng shui master into relocating his great grandfather's coffin - and pays the price.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.title: Europe Raiders
programme.desc: Director Jingle Ma reunites with Tony Leung for the 3rd instalment of the Raider's series, revolving the adventure of 2 top bounty hunters as they search for the destructive missile called Hand of God.

programme.title: The Sparring Partner
programme.desc: A top-rated film based on a true case in Hong Kong, it tells of a young man who plots with his friend to murder & dismember his parents, resulting in a highly controversial court case.

programme.title: The Calling of a Bus Driver
programme.desc: Based on a true story, a girl named Suki aspire to fulfill her dream after leaving with her cheating boyfriend. Later, when invited to attend his wedding, she schemes to have her revenge.

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: A veteran and a passionate street dancer both strive to reach their goals and pursue their dreams in street dancing. After overcoming many challenges, can they finally shine on stage?

programme.title: P Storm
programme.desc: Ping reports a case of prison corruption to the ICAC. ICAC officer Luk goes undercover in prison to investigate and is determined to complete his mission with the help of his cell mate, Wang.

programme.title: Hong Kong Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee, a production head of an advertising firm, runs into her ex-boyfriend before a commercial shoot & drowns her sorrows drinking at Lan Kwai Fong. She picks herself up with Chan's help.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai is framed for murder. He takes hostages at the police station and demands talk with a former negotiator. As they engage in a tense battle of wits, their perspectives gradually shift.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Gambler
programme.desc: Manfred & Flora are a married couple with a gambling addiction. During their divorce, to decide who gets their daughter's custody right, the judge orders the couple to quit gambling for a week.

programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: I Love Hong Kong 2012
programme.desc: Featuring an all HK-star cast, this movie depicts how a weatherman is faced with the biggest challenge of his life when he receives a shocking forecast.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: When a school bus driver is injured after risking his life to save a boy during an accident, the boy's father invites him to live with them. However, disturbing facts soon begin to emerge.

programme.title: Happy Dragons
programme.desc: Four retired secret agents embark on a quest for the 'Golden Relic' which turns back time and restores their youth. As they strive to rectify past mistakes, they unravel a hidden conspiracy.

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a case where the body was undiscovered for 8 years. During the investigation, the prosecutor finds all inconsistencies & suspicions fall on Choi.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the 'Eagle Gang', a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers.

programme.title: CZ12
programme.desc: Jackie Chan stars as the Asian Hawk, a top agent sent to retrieve the bronze heads of twelve animals of the Chinese Zodiac, stolen in Beijing in 1860.

programme.title: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about abuse in a care home for elderly and disabled. Reporter Kay goes undercover to unveil the cruel truth in broad daylight.

programme.title: Echoes of the Thunder
programme.desc: Nam and Fire are top racing drivers. Nam is depressed after causing a young racing driver's injury. Fire decides to compete in an illegal street car race to stand up for Nam. Can he succeed finally?

programme.title: iGirl
programme.desc: The 1st Asian New Media FF's Best Actress Chrissie Chau reunites with Ekin Cheng in this story of three jilted men, who decide to invest in android girlfriends.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis, his marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him.

programme.title: Young Ip Man Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling, who dreams of becoming a secret agent, accidentally rescues an injured spy. He agrees to make her his apprentice, turning her upside down as she goes on madcap adventures.

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: The owner of a small cleaning company, Chak, experiences a tough time during the pandemic. When he employs single mother Candy as his assistant, she became his saving grace.

programme.title: We are Family
programme.desc: "Rent-a-Family" offers relatives for rent and in the process, the trio rendering such services discover the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica falls for an online dating app scam with young Joe, who poses as a French engineer. What begins as a romance built on lies ultimately transforms two seemingly mismatched souls.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The HK Police placed over a thousand undercover officers in various triads, attempting to bring down the country's largest criminal organization, prompting betrayal, deceit & murder.

programme.title: The Lady Iron Chef
programme.desc: In order to win her future mother-in-law's approval, Ceci must be crowned in a gourmet cooking competition. However, there's a catch; Ceci is terrible at cooking.

programme.title: Come Back Home
programme.desc: De & family goes on a drive to Changbai Mountain, where their magical holiday turns tragic when their 8-year-old son goes missing. Will they be able to find him before the cold winter takes him?

programme.title: The Moon Thieves

programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: Starring John Chiang, Ti Lung, Yueh Wah, Ku Feng and Chen Kuan Tai, this classic depicts how the brothers of the classic Water Margin fight local authorities.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: A nightclub owner (Peter Chen Ho) has his way with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Also starring Lily Ho, Chin Ping.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: A wanna-be-detective/swordsman gets more than he bargained for when investigating the disappearance of some martial artists.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: The dedicated wife of a man being pressured by a nasty belly dancer uncovers a pit of deceit, double-crosses, murder and blackmail.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: When a swordswoman falters in her attempt to reclaim her murdered husband's 'Green Sword', the world's sharpest blade, her protg continues her quest.

programme.title: Songfest
programme.desc: This Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musical depicts a turbulent romance between Yu Lan, a passionate tea picker and a charming fisherman named Chun Yang.

programme.title: The Five Venoms

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: In this chapter of the 'Journey to the West' saga, the Monkey King and his gang are confronted by a whole host of fanciful villains.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: A man devotes his life to mastering the sword in order to exact revenge on the three men who killed his family and abducted his sister.

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of female warriors and a group of ruthless bandits who teams up to raid the emperor's tomb. Will they be successful?

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: A righteous man who can't fight and an unjustly wronged swordsman team up to battle against evil.

programme.title: Young Lovers

programme.title: Legend of the Bat

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: This moving tale centers on a childless woman who cares for an emotionally battered girl.

programme.title: Four Riders

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth

programme.title: The Golden Lion

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West

programme.title: Puppy Love

programme.title: The Secret of the Dirk

programme.title: Duel of Fist

programme.title: Family Light Affair

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun

programme.desc: SEGMEN HIBURAN LAGU-LAGU BAHARU DAN LAMA SERTA PADAT DENGAN INFORMASI UNTUK WANITA, KEKELUARGAAN, SIARAN ULANGAN TERPILIH, CERITA RAKYAT SELAIN PENGUMUMAN KHIDMAT MASYARAKAT/AWAM (CSA/PSA)/PROMO/KAPSUL.

programme.title: RADIO TAU (LIMBANGfm)
programme.desc: SEGMEN PERKHIDMATAN LUN BAWANG (LIMBANGfm) DARI 12.00-3.00 P.M. MENAMPILKAN LAGU-LAGU RAKYAT/MALAR SEGAR/KEAGAMAAN, MAKLUMAT TERKINI, BERITA KELUARGA , PSA/CSA, PROMO, JINGLE, KAPSUL DAN TEASER RANCANGAN.

programme.title: PEJI DAHIN KELO' (MIRIfm)
programme.desc: SEGMEN PERKHIDMATAN KAYAN (MIRIfm) DARI 3.00-5.00 P.M. DENGAN PENGISIAN LAGU-LAGU, INFO TERKINI, BERITA KELUARGA, PSA/CSA, KAPSUL, CARTA LAGU, LAGU KEROHANIAN, PROGRAM KANAK-KANAK DAN MUZIK TRADISIONAL.

programme.title: PEMUNG KEJAIE (MIRIfm)
programme.desc: SEGMEN PERKHIDMATAN KENYAH (MIRIfm) DARI 5.00-6.00 P.M. DENGAN PENGISIAN PROGRAM BERSAMA AGENSI, MOTIVASI, SEMBANG BUDAYA, CARTA LAGU ORANG ULU, PROGRAM KANAK-KANAK, LAGU-LAGU PERMINTAAN, BERITA KELUARGA.

programme.title: SADA ARI LIMBANG (LIMBANGfm)
programme.desc: SADA ARI LIMBANG (LIMBANGfm) SETIAP KHAMIS DARI 6.00-9.00 P.M MENAMPILKAN PENYAMPAI DARI KONTI LIMBANGfm DENGAN PENGISIAN PELBAGAI PROGRAM BUAL BICARA, BERITA KELUARGA, PILIHAN LAGU-LAGU LAMA/FOLKLORE.

programme.title: PEMERINDANG MALAM (WAIfm IBAN)
programme.desc: SEGMEN SANTAI MALAM MENGANDUNGI PILIHAN LAGU-LAGU NOSTALGIA/MALAR SEGAR, FOLKLORE (SANGGAI, RAMBAN, SAMPI, TIMANG JALONG/PELIAN, ENSERA, GANU/JAWANG/DUNGAI, RENONG/SUGI), SELAIN INFO PDRM, KISAH BENAR.

programme.title: Blood and Black Lace
programme.desc: A masked man with a metal-claw glove stalks models at a couple's (Cameron Mitchell, Eva Bartok) fashion salon in Rome.

programme.title: I Bury the Living
programme.desc: Robert Kraft (Richard Boone) inherits a familial post as the chairman of a small-town cemetery. The centerpiece of the cemetery office is a map of all the plots: White pins signify those claimed, black pins those occupied. When Robert accidentally puts a black pin in the just-purchased plots of a friend (Glenn Vernon) and his new wife, they die in a freak accident. Robert's uncle (Howard Smith) convinces him to make another switch, to see if it's coincidence or something more sinister.

programme.title: A Bucket of Blood
programme.desc: Nerdy Walter Paisley (Dick Miller), a maladroit busboy at a beatnik café who doesn't fit in with the cool scene around him, attempts to woo his beautiful co-worker, Carla (Barboura Morris), by making a bust of her. When his klutziness results in the death of his landlady's cat, he panics and hides its body under a layer of plaster. But when Carla and her friends enthuse over the resulting artwork, Walter decides to create some bigger and more elaborate pieces using the same artistic process.

programme.title: Secret Experiment
programme.desc: While working in the lab, scientist Peter Brady gets exposed to a radiation leak and becomes invisible; the British government wants to classify him as top secret and lock him up, but he escapes.

programme.title: The Mysterious Mr. M
programme.desc: A federal agent must stop an evil scientist from deploying a drug that will enable him to steal submarine parts.

programme.title: The Nick Joseph Story
programme.desc: An ex-con makes a deal with police for a reduced sentence.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: A New York cop fights organized crime in the Roaring '20s.

programme.title: The Jane Cooper Story
programme.desc: Out on parole, Jane Cooper goes from man to man, and police see that her former boyfriends are meeting tragic ends.

programme.title: The Cutie Jaffe Story
programme.desc: A bootlegger gets in trouble when he begins to hijack shipments.

programme.title: The Dutch Schultz Story
programme.desc: A New York cop fights organized crime in the Roaring '20s.

programme.title: The Lion and the Mouse
programme.desc: A New York cop fights organized crime in the Roaring '20s.

programme.title: No Fare
programme.desc: The underworld bribes a police detective into withholding information during a murder investigation.

programme.title: The Payoff
programme.desc: A woman pays with her life when she breaks up with a bootlegger.

programme.title: The Marie Walters Story
programme.desc: A gangster kills a rival crime boss for his employer, but finds himself involved in a double cross that may also prove deadly.

programme.title: The Maxie Gorman Story
programme.desc: A New York cop fights organized crime in the Roaring '20s.

programme.title: The Muddy Kasoff Story
programme.desc: A New York cop fights organized crime in the Roaring '20s.

programme.title: Framed
programme.desc: A New York cop fights organized crime in the Roaring '20s.

programme.title: Four the Hard Way
programme.desc: A New York cop fights organized crime in the Roaring '20s.

programme.title: The Tony Morelli Story
programme.desc: The mob leans on a hardworking family man who tries to rebuff them, but they use his wife and son as leverage; when he succumbs to the pressure, it's up to Ruditsky to set things right and keep the family together.

programme.title: The Ray Baker Story
programme.desc: A racketeer is accused of killing a young girl during a wild party.

programme.title: Lucky Silva
programme.desc: Small-time hood Rico Silva is dubbed "Lucky" by Barney Ruditsky after he survived having his handsome face slashed to ribbons by Legs Diamond's mob.

programme.title: The Morrison Story
programme.desc: Ruditsky investigates a crooked judge.

programme.title: The Poison Ivy Story
programme.desc: A corrupt judge is investigated.

programme.title: The Al Brown Story
programme.desc: A mother tells the cops where her criminal son is hiding; television and movie veteran Jack Weston stars in "The Al Brown Story," originally aired in 1959.

programme.title: The Big Greeny Story
programme.desc: A contract killer carries out an assignment, only to become a target himself.

programme.title: The Art Harris Story
programme.desc: A crook goes into politics to protect his criminal interests.

programme.title: The Billy Boy "Rockabye" Creel Story
programme.desc: Mob boss Bobo Konig puts a bounty of $50,000 on psychotic gunman Billy Boy Creel, who immediately goes underground; Ruditsky tries to find Billy Boy before Konig's killers do.

programme.title: Second Avenue Assassin
programme.desc: Mike investigates fixed boxing matches.

programme.title: The Warning
programme.desc: Mike is forced to photograph a murder.

programme.title: Profile of a Killer
programme.desc: Mike is kidnapped by bank robbers.

programme.title: Close-Up On Violence
programme.desc: Thugs steal Mike's camera.

programme.title: Turntable
programme.desc: A fake photo of a senator surfaces.

programme.title: Double Negative
programme.desc: A reporter and a nightclub singer try to frame Mike.

programme.title: Another Barrier
programme.desc: A pilot and his plane go missing.

programme.title: Blind Spot
programme.desc: Mike's friend is murdered in Lisbon.

programme.title: Two Strings of Pearls
programme.desc: Mike notices a woman working with a con artist.

programme.title: Six Faces of Satan
programme.desc: A young woman claims to have been beaten.

programme.title: Lady on the Loose
programme.desc: The daughter of a millionaire asks Mike to show her around the city.

programme.title: The Last Portrait
programme.desc: Mike is accused of using a gun hidden inside a camera.

programme.title: The Face of Murder
programme.desc: Mike and a priest are taken hostage by a prisoner.

programme.title: Mute Evidence
programme.desc: Mike investigates the murder of a doctor.

programme.title: The Big Squeeze
programme.desc: Mike is asked to find the person who murdered a gangster.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Mike is shot while on assignment.

programme.title: Eye Witness
programme.desc: Mike uses a picture to prove an old man's innocence.

programme.title: The Man Below
programme.desc: A woman plans to have her husband killed in order to collect his life insurance.

programme.title: Black Light
programme.desc: Officers may be taking bribes.

programme.title: The Positive Negative
programme.desc: Mike is abducted by mobsters.

programme.title: Missing
programme.desc: Mike is asked to find a missing woman.

programme.title: Live Target
programme.desc: A gunman threatens the life of a witness.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: Murder Legendre is the menacingly named zombie master of Haiti. Charles Beaumont goes to him when he needs help for a twisted plan. Spurned in marriage by Madeline Short, Beaumont has decided on a simple solution: kill Short and bring her back as a zombie. Then he can be with her forever. The only problem comes when Legendre keeps the fetching girl for himself -- and her new husband comes to Madeline's rescue.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: While on shore leave, sailor Johnny Drake (Dennis Hopper) becomes enamored of Mora (Linda Lawson), a young woman who works as a "mermaid" at a sideshow attraction. But for Mora it's no act. She actually believes that she really is a mermaid who is destined to murder men on the night of a full moon. Drake is still captivated by the mysterious woman, however, and begins to suspect that her boss, Capt. Murdock (Gavin Muir), may have something to do with Mora's murderous thoughts.

programme.title: New Life Begins Ep35
programme.desc: Starring Bai Jing Ting & Tian Xi Wei, the story begins with the marriage selection for the young masters of the Xin Chuan family. Yin Zheng, the 6th son who keeps a low profile, & Li Wei, who worked hard not to get selected, unexpectedly start a new life as husband & wife. As the two gradually develop feelings through their common interest in food, they begin to bond as a real married couple.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: There's excitement as the first baby giraffe to be born at Flamingoland is due at any moment. Can Dr. Matt ensure a safe delivery? And a young male rhino needs a medical MOT before he can meet some females but he just won't co-operate. Meanwhile a macaw with a twisted beak presents Matt with a bit of a challenge.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet Coming
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got stupid vs intelligent dogs, talented dogs, sporty dogs, pug life, dogs getting stuck, sleepy dogs, and dogs acting like humans.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks. Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out. Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue. She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs. Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! How can one be the creator of the underwater world? Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt and the keepers at Flamingoland come up with a cunning plan as they face the difficult task of trying to move a three and a half ton white rhino to Sweden. On a much smaller scale, an abandoned rabbit with an urgent dental problem and Matt discovers that picking up a penguin isn't as easy as it sounds.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Herchy Boal teams up with the police to attend a property near Birmingham suspected of puppy farming. Tragically, for one puppy it was already too late, but she manages to rescue another 37 including 8 expectant mothers. Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?

programme.title: Cute Pet Coming
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers

Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?

programme.title: Cute Pet Coming
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers

programme.title: Best Of Pets

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: SpongeBob's pet is Gary the Snail! Which cute pet has characteristics of both Gary and Mr. Krabs? "Cute Pet Guide" wants to introduce you to these little guys with shells on their backs - hermit crabs: as their bodies grow, they must shed their shells and move to new homes. In addition to that, there are many little-known secrets of them waiting for you to explore!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: An orphaned badger cub puts up a fight when Dr. Matt gets him on the operating table. At Flamingoland, all's not well with a baby giraffe rejected by his mother at birth. Will he be well enough to face a reunion with mum? And back at the surgery, Matt must make a tough decision on Daisy an elderly cat.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pet Coming
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: The Commando
programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: Peter Five Eight
programme.desc: Sam, a seemingly poised and glamorous real estate agent in a small mountain community is revealed to be an unhinged and troubled alcoholic with a dark secret, when a charismatic man in a black sedan named Peter shows up in town one day.

programme.title: Broken Star
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: A Las Vegas casino magnate, determined to find a new avenue for wagering, sets up a race for money.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
